title: (Un)certainty of (Un)fairness: Preference-Based Selection of Certainly Fair Decision-Makers
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a mathematical and statistical framework for quantifying uncertainty in group fairness metrics (specifically statistical disparity). While fairness is an ethical topic, the paper provides a technical contribution to measurement and decision theory for general machine learning models (like SVM and Random Forest) rather than evaluating religious values, moral reasoning, or broad ethical frameworks in LLMs or NLP systems.
